notes.title: Update on July 25
notes.notes:
VR Update Contents

[olist]
Addition of options screen
Created a "Volume Adjustment" function to adjust the volume, a "Height Adjustment" function to adjust the height of the character, and an "Exit" function to log out of the room.
Creation of Status Screen
Until now, you could only see your own status in HP or MP, but we added a function to allow you to check your status at any time in the game.
Improved operability
Previously, the character's orientation was linked to the player's orientation.
However, we realized that when playing indoors, some people are in an environment where they cannot actually look around.
Therefore, we made it possible to control the viewpoint from the controller.
[/olist]


Common updates for PC & VR versions

[olist]
 Improvements around combat
Various improvements have been made, such as giving NPCs weapon attack detection only when attacking, and playing sounds depending on the weapon when NPCs attack.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update on June 17, 2022
notes.notes:
This update is mainly for the VR version, but the PC version also includes minor adjustments.

1. Added a function to adjust the position of the character using a mirror when selecting the character at the beginning of the game
2. Adjusted the display position of various UI.
3. Fixed a bug that prevented the ED from playing.
Fixed a synchronization bug when other players joined in the middle of the game.
